notes: Prospective observational study (LOUVRE) of consecutive patients treated with DEX implant at baseline in routine practice in France; role control.
BCVA was measured with an ETDRS chart or the Monoyer scale; Tab2 states ETDRS letters with no Snellen or decimal row, which establishes the unit (brief ruling on units).

Efficacy analyses used observed values with no replacement of missing values in all enrolled patients with baseline BCVA (missing_data observed); month-6 BCVA was missing for part of the analysis population and not every patient completed the 2-year study (ordinary attrition).

Re-treatment with DEX implant and other RVO treatments (mostly laser or anti-VEGF) were given at the physician's discretion, and eyes that had cataract surgery were not excluded; values after these events were not removed or replaced, so all visits are kept.
The analysis population includes treatment-naive and previously treated eyes (Tab1); the prior-treatment split within each diagnosis subgroup is not reported (prior_treatment mixed).
Central retinal thickness, IOP, numbers of implants and quality of life are not extracted.
